h1: Custom 3 oz Products for Promotional Use
metaDescription: Browse custom 3 oz products for giveaways and events. Order branded samples and bulk quantities at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Choosing a 3 oz size for your promotional products offers a compact and portable option that fits easily into pockets, purses, or giveaway bags. Whether you need custom hand sanitizers for trade shows, sample-sized lotions for hotel amenities, or mini sunscreen tubes for outdoor events, the 3 oz format meets TSA carry-on requirements and is ideal for cost-effective bulk ordering. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or labels for maximum brand exposure.
heroAltText: Custom 3 oz products including branded hand sanitizer and lotion bottles with company logos
